description: The weather right now, and whether this year's rain is above or below normal
summary: This page shows the latest weather reading for {district} (from OpenWeatherMap) and monthly rainfall against the normal for each month (from the India Meteorological Department, IMD). Temperature is in degrees Celsius, wind in kilometres an hour and rain in millimetres. Each reading shows the time it was recorded.
